policy.reference_method: pivoted Householder QR; triangular solves; independently accumulated Bartlett sandwich
policy.primary_sample: independently reconstruct all five-model complete-case dates per asset

limited_sensitivity.rule: exclude every dependent-portfolio constituent from each characteristic factor leg at signal formation; renormalize remaining positive original cap weights within the same original leg; never rerank
limited_sensitivity.missing_rule: missing or empty leg is unavailable; no synthetic return, cash or fallback
limited_sensitivity.sample: restrict to original primary dates and all-five-model complete cases; at least 24 observations and full rank in all models; refit unchanged baseline on identical retained dates/assets
limited_sensitivity.market: retain the authenticated SPY proxy; its underlying constituent exclusions cannot be verified with available inputs
limited_sensitivity.interpretation: predetermined diagnostic reducing direct characteristic-leg self-inclusion; not an independent external-factor study or replacement publication
limited_sensitivity.no_tuning: one specification only; report all exclusions and outcomes without choosing favorable rankings

policy.multiplicity: Holm familywise adjustment within each model and across all 615 primary intercepts; valid under arbitrary test dependence conditional on valid marginal p-values; exploratory and does not repair HAC assumptions
